From the tender age of 2.5 years, my daughter’s journey with TLC (Tender Love and Care) began, and it has been a cherished chapter for both of us. As a mother, finding the right environment where my child could flourish emotionally, intellectually, and socially while feeling safe and secure was a top priority. TLC, with its nurturing and holistic approach, provided exactly that, setting a high standard for how early childhood education should be.

The whole team at TLC has been instrumental in shaping my daughter’s formative years, but it’s Esha Imran’s warmth and attention to detail that stand out. She, along with the rest of the staff, treated my daughter not just as another student but as a child deserving individual attention, love, and care. Whether through everyday classroom interactions or special moments during school events, TLC fostered an environment where my daughter felt safe, loved, and excited to explore the world around her.

Over the years, as a single mom, I’ve watched my daughter evolve from a curious toddler into an independent, thoughtful, and creative young girl. The early days of discovering new words, learning how to socialize, and developing her fine motor skills gradually transitioned into more complex, exploratory learning experiences. TLC encouraged her natural curiosity and guided her through a balanced mix of play-based learning and structured activities.

Now, as she graduates from TLC at the age of six, she is well-equipped for her next chapter of exploration and discovery. The foundation laid during these early years has instilled a love for learning in her, something I will forever be grateful for. TLC didn’t just prepare her academically; it nurtured her emotionally, building her confidence to face the world and take on new challenges with enthusiasm and resilience.

As we embark on this next journey, I know that the seeds of curiosity, compassion, and confidence sown at TLC will continue to grow. From the bottom of my heart, thank you to everyone at TLC for giving my child such a wonderful start in life, and a special thanks to Esha Imran for the tender love and care that will always remain with us.

I’d also like to acknowledge Teacher Sara’s exceptional efforts in elevating the learning curve, teaching them to read, write, and count, all while incorporating wellness and kindness into their daily lives, shaping them into beautiful tiny humans who will carry these values throughout their lives.", "date": "a year ago"}]
